## Problem Description

We collect more data than ever, but most audiences don't care about your model - they care about what it means for them.

## Analysis

For ETC5523, I translated a technical report for non-technical readers.

![Story-first visuals improve recall](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551288049-bebda4e38f71?w=800){#fig-impact}

See @fig-impact - audience recall improves when we lead with implication.

| Format | Recall |
|---|---|
| Data Table | 23% |
| Story + Visual | 71% |

: Recall by format {#tbl-summary}

@tbl-summary shows the same. As @knaflic2015 notes, storytelling is the delivery mechanism.

## Conclusion

Start with their question, not your dataset.
